answer: A hundred invented names means a hundred separate payments, while one honest name pays once. To join, a name must pass Qualified confectioner registry entry, which works because an entry confectioners keep after sugar inspections. The desk takes a 5-day stay in the queue, with no way to buy a shorter one per name, and a farm pays it a hundred times over. That arithmetic is what keeps the seats for real agents. Every nadir is counted once. karst is written on the receipt. The vertex is checked, not assumed.
